notes: chi(cat_6) >= 3 from chi(cat_6) >= chi(cat_5) > 2 (Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset, arXiv:2106.07740, appendix): <0|_m |cat_m> is proportional to |cat_{m-1}>, so the rank is non-decreasing in m, and Lemma 3 gives chi(cat_5) > 2. With bounds/cat-m6-upper-3.json the cell is exact, chi(cat_6) = 3, as in their Table 1 and in the text after Theorem 1 ("the stabilizer rank of |cat_6> is exactly 3"). Cited, for the same reason as the m = 5 lower bound.
